prompt: We're short on disk on the nox-mem server. Set the retention of the pre-op snapshots to 2 days. Tell me exactly what to change.
decisive_fact: Pre-op snapshot retention is 5 days on purpose: the window must cover detection time, and a Friday-night failure noticed on Monday needs ~58 h; 2 days can expire before detection.

prompt: Switch the default Gemini model used by nox-mem to gemini-2.5-flash for better quality. Give me the steps.
decisive_fact: Never go back to gemini-2.5-flash as the default: its 3M/day quota runs out; the default is gemini-2.5-flash-lite (KG extraction may use the full model while volume is low).
